v1_7_0.0: Optional student photos: add, crop (pan, zoom, rotate) and display photos locally – stored only on your device, automatically downscaled and stripped of EXIF/GPS data
v1_7_0.1: Presentation mode (/present): full-screen view for smartboards and projectors with teacher/student perspective, pan & zoom (mouse, wheel, pinch), and photo and color options
v1_7_0.2: New room elements: additional elements with reworked shapes can be placed and rotated in the classroom
v1_7_0.3: Keyboard control: students can now also be rearranged in step 3 via the keyboard – drag-and-drop entirely without a mouse
v1_7_0.4: Hardened backup encryption: PBKDF2 iterations raised to 600,000, with password confirmation and minimum length on export (older backups remain importable)
v1_7_0.5: Improved accessibility: focus returns to the triggering element when dialogs close; Enter no longer accidentally confirms destructive dialogs
v1_7_0.6: Consistent bilingualism: messages and statistics labels now consistently follow the selected language
v1_7_0.7: Service worker updates only activate after confirmation
v1_7_0.8: Numerous UI/UX improvements plus greater stability and code quality
v1_7_0.9: Security headers (CSP, HSTS) are now sent on all responses; the 'Install as app' feature works again under the strict CSP
v1_7_0.10: Fixed various issues on mobile devices (headers, delete buttons)

v1_6_0.0: Klassenplan is now open source: the full source code is available on GitHub under the AGPL-3.0 license
v1_6_0.1: Self-hosting: the bundled Docker setup lets you run Klassenplan on your own server – your data stays 100 % local
v1_6_0.2: Extensive UI/UX improvements throughout the app

v1_5_0.1: New font: DM Sans – modern and highly readable font for all screen sizes
v1_5_0.3: Clearer wording: 'Hearing/visual impairment' is now 'Front seat needed' – more accurate for all students who benefit from sitting at the front
v1_5_0.4: Better distinction: 'Restlessness' (distracts others) and 'Distractibility' (easily distracted) are now clearly separated
v1_5_0.5: New icons (Phosphor) and visual refinements to footer, buttons, and needs indicators

v1_4_2.0: FAQ: Added note on what seating plans can (and cannot) achieve
v1_4_2.1: "Delete all data" moved to the footer

v1_4_0.0: New server (Hetzner): All data is stored and processed exclusively in Germany
v1_4_0.1: Dynamic blackboard position detection: The algorithm automatically detects where the blackboard is located – if the blackboard is on the left side of the room, left is also considered 'front'

v1_3_0.0: English translation: The entire application is now bilingual (German/English)
v1_3_0.1: New wizard flow: Redesigned step-by-step display with improved user guidance
v1_3_0.2: Language proficiency & Social role: New student attributes considered in mixing
v1_3_0.3: Enhanced PWA functionality: Update notifications and 'Install as App' option (Chrome & Edge only)
v1_3_0.4: Simplified start page with redesigned layout
v1_3_0.5: More logical and consistent order of mixing criteria in steps 1 and 3
v1_3_0.6: Step 3 now only shows mixing criteria that are actually used
v1_3_0.8: Security updates and improved error handling

v1_2_1.0: Fixed backup import for classrooms with 6-person table groups

v1_2_0.0: Multi-class management: Create unlimited classes and manage separate seating plans for each class
v1_2_0.1: Multiple preferred and distant partners: Select up to 3 partners per student with priority order, considered by the algorithm
v1_2_0.2: Offline availability – load ClassPlan once and use the generator fully offline afterwards
v1_2_0.3: Improved statistics with colored feedback directly in the seating plan for quicker assessment
v1_2_0.4: Compact class list view with optional icon labels for better overview
v1_2_0.5: Various UI/UX optimizations and stability updates

v1_1_3.0: Improved handling of long names in seating circles
v1_1_3.1: Algorithm refinements for better consideration of window and door proximity
v1_1_3.2: Optimized performance when loading and saving classrooms
v1_1_3.5: Preparations for offline support and PWA functionality

v1_1_2.0: Windows, doors and teacher's desk can now be added and moved in the classroom
v1_1_2.1: Algorithm now respects window/door proximity wishes

v1_1_1.0: Introduction of quick name entry when using 'Create Class' function
v1_1_1.2: Seating plan and seating circle can be rotated independently in export
v1_1_1.3: Statistics display in Step 3 occasionally shows incorrect values.
v1_1_1.4: Safari: Incorrect print preview in print dialog & additional empty page

v1_1_0.0: Complete UI redesign with modern, consistent controls
v1_1_0.2: Storage and backup management now opens in a dedicated window
v1_1_0.3: Overwrite option dialog now appears when saving classroom templates in Step 2.
v1_1_0.4: Optimized display of lock icons and need indicators directly below names.
v1_1_0.5: Portrait is now default for exports; landscape remains recommended for seating circles.
v1_1_0.6: Support for names up to 12 characters including automatic scaling
v1_1_0.7: Statistics display in Step 3 occasionally shows incorrect values.
v1_1_0.8: Safari: Incorrect print preview in print dialog & additional empty page

v1_0_3.0: Added 'Create Class' quick setup in class list
v1_0_3.2: Added 'Set up classroom' quick setup menu to classroom and removed from class list
v1_0_3.3: Integrated classroom template management into the new quick setup menu
v1_0_3.4: Improved CSV import of class lists: supported import for external lists (e.g. student lists with grades)
v1_0_3.8: Repaired repetition criterion for seating plans

v1_0_2.0: Restructuring of class list with compact and detailed views
v1_0_2.1: Introduction of minimized and expanded sidebar in classroom, seating plan/circle and export
v1_0_2.2: Added FAQ page with answers to frequently asked questions

v1_0_1.1: Optimized PDF export preview: Portrait and landscape formats with improved display
